verdict.rationale: First-party docs state ChatGPT can "read files, analyze data, and summarize findings" and list "analyze files" as a core use case. Docs also reference uploading files to a cloud conversation in Work on the Web, and community users praise the file-upload/interpretation capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that PDFs and spreadsheets are supported as uploaded inputs (the file-type docs cover output drafting), details on file-analysis depth or limits, and independent hands-on evidence that the analysis is accurate.
